# Regulatory Compliance and Legal Risk Monitoring

This document outlines key directives for maintaining compliance and managing legal risks within the bank.

## Key Directives:

*   Monitor regulatory changes on a quarterly basis to ensure continuous adherence.
*   Update internal controls promptly based on audit recommendations.
*   Monitor legal risks diligently, informed by audit findings.
*   Address and update legal risks with urgency.
*   Integrate audit-based findings to update regulatory changes effectively.
